title: Service Call Cancellation and No-Access Fees — Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
## Terms

**Free cancellation.** A booked call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls cancelled at the customer's request at least the class's free-cancellation notice in elapsed hours before the start of its arrival window is cancelled without charge.

**Late cancellation.** A booked call cancelled with less notice but before dispatch is charged a late cancellation fee of the class's late cancellation fee, where that fee is above $0.00.

**Trip fee.** A call cancelled after dispatch is cancelled with a trip fee of the class's trip fee. So is a call where the technician waits the class's on-site wait without getting access.

**No visit charges.** A call that never reaches completion carries no diagnostic fee, premium or tune-up charge.

**No fee.** A call cancelled by Harbison carries no fee. So does a call cancelled because a declared weather emergency closed the roads.

**One fee only.** Only one cancellation fee, late or trip, is charged per call. Whether the call already carries a trip fee or late cancellation fee line is read from that call's invoice lines.

## Decision table

| When and why the call ends | Fee |
|---|---|
| Customer cancels a booked call with at least the class's notice | None |
| Customer cancels a booked call with less notice, before dispatch | Class's late cancellation fee, if above $0.00 |
| Customer cancels after dispatch | Class's trip fee |
| Technician waits the on-site wait without access | Class's trip fee |
| Harbison cancels | None |
| Declared weather emergency closed the roads | None |
| Call already carries a late cancellation fee or trip fee | No second cancellation fee |

## Cases (hypothetical, using the published class figures)

- A Standard Service Call with an 08:00-12:00 window is cancelled at 10:00 the day before. That is 22 hours of notice, less than 24, and before dispatch. The Standard late cancellation fee is $0.00, so no fee is charged.
- A Same-Day Priority Service Call is cancelled after the technician was dispatched. The trip fee of $119.00 is charged, and no diagnostic fee.
- An Evening Service Call technician waits 15 minutes at the door without access. The call is cancelled with the $129.00 trip fee.
